2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes, Walker spark Chiefs to romp over Broncos
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Denver Broncos' offense struggled to find rhythm against the Kansas City Chiefs' defense, led by Kenneth Walker's 173 rushing yards and Patrick Mahomes' return from injury. The Broncos' pass rush, which got home on 9.3% of opponents' pass plays last season, faced a Kansas City protection unit that allowed sacks on 6.4% of pass plays. Denver's offense, under new coordinator Davis Webb, failed to establish a consistent run game, finishing with just 61 ground yards.
